description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ProjectListViewData', which extends 'ListViewData' and provides methods related to displaying list view data for projects in SuiteCRM. It includes a method to generate an AJAX call for additional details display, and contains licensing and environment setup code.

classes.name: ProjectListViewData
classes.description: A data holder class for project list views, extending ListViewData, with methods for AJAX detail retrieval.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Generates HTML for AJAX-loaded additional details span with click handler to load details for a project record.
